    • names

      public FlatFileItemWriterBuilder<T> names(String... names)
      Names of each of the fields within the fields that are returned in the order they occur within the delimited file. These names will be used to create a BeanWrapperFieldExtractor only if no explicit field extractor is set via fieldExtractor(FieldExtractor).
      参数:
      names - names of each field
      返回:
      The parent FlatFileItemWriterBuilder
